scripts.title: SHADOW HUB
scripts.features:
SHADOW HUB V1.1 _ UPDATE LOG _
- [Fixed] Universal World Farming — The script now correctly scans and targets NPCs across all unlocked maps (Forest, Desert, Winter, etc.), not just the Plains.
(it's worth choosing your location, for example: Forest, which requires only 2 rebirths, otherwise a kick is possible for suspected cheats)

- [Fixed] Persistent Loop Leaks — Using "Destroy UI" now fully terminates all background processes, including auto-upgrades and rebirthing.

- [Fixed] Menu Persistence — Fixed a bug where the UI would disappear or break after character death. The hub now stays active and accessible via the [M] key.

- [Improved] Aggressive Auto-Equip — Completely rewrote the tool handler. It now forces the Wand into your hands every 0.1s during farming.

- [Improved] Compact UI Design — Refined the menu layout for better visibility while maintaining a sleek, modern dark aesthetic.
